description: This file implements a JSON request handler thread for a host interface, including HTTP server setup, JSON parsing with YAJL, and request handling for TR-069 protocol.

methods.name: jsonIfHandlerThread
methods.description: Thread function that starts the HTTP server for JSON requests.

methods.name: hostIf_HTTPJsonParse
methods.description: Parses incoming JSON message using YAJL and returns a list of parameters.

methods.name: hostIf_HTTPJsonMsgHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP JSON messages, parses request, and sends JSON response.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStart
methods.description: Initializes and starts the HTTP server to serve JSON client requests.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStop
methods.description: Stops the HTTP server by disconnecting the SoupServer.
